title: Implement layered configuration resolution
prompt: src/config.py declares resolve_config(layers) but does not implement it. It must merge a sequence of nested configuration dictionaries, where later layers override earlier ones. Nested dictionaries merge recursively; every other value type (including lists) is replaced wholesale. Input layers must never be mutated. Raise ConfigError with a dotted key path when two layers disagree on whether a key holds a mapping. Implement it so the existing test suite passes.
acceptance_criteria: resolve_config merges layers left to right, later layers winning.
Nested mappings merge recursively; every other value type is replaced wholesale.
Input layers are never mutated, at any depth.
A key that is a mapping in one layer and a non-mapping in another raises ConfigError.
The ConfigError message names the conflicting key by dotted path.
